# rings_by_size_rdkit { #mofography.analyze.rings_by_size_rdkit }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> RDKit ring perception by size when RDKit-centric workflows are preferred. Use `compute_aromatic_cycles` instead.
